test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The kids have been __pestering__ me to buy them new toys.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pacifying**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**pestering**' is '**pacifying**'.
 
• **Pestering**: to annoy somebody, for example by asking him/her something many times. [व्‍यक्ति को परेशान कर देना (एक बात को अनेक बार पूछ कर या अन्‍य प्रकार से)]
 
 
• *Example: to **pester** somebody for money...*
 
 
 
• **Pacifying**: to make somebody who is angry or upset be calm or quiet. (किसी नाराज़ या परेशान व्‍यक्ति को शांत एवं स्थिर करना)
 
 
• *Example: If he **pacifies** him skilfully enough, he might even make another sale on his colleague's behalf.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *pacifying.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **perturbing**: to make somebody worried or upset. (किसी को चिंतित या परेशान कर देना)
 
• **bugging**: to hide a very small device (microphone) somewhere so that people’s conversations can be recorded secretly. (गुप्‍त माइक्रोफ़ोन को चोरी-छिपे लगा देना)
 
• **tormenting**: inflicting severe physical or mental suffering. (किसी को तीव्र मानसिक या शारीरिक पीड़ा पहुँचाना)
